title: A Visit to the Market
text:
Mia goes to the market with her mom. They need apples, bread and milk. The market is busy and the sellers are friendly. Mia carries the bag of apples.

At the market, Mia sees a blue hat. It costs five dollars. Her mom says yes, so Mia buys the hat. Now Mia is very happy.

questions.text: Who goes to the market with Mia?
What color is the hat Mia sees?
Why is Mia very happy at the end?
options: She got the hat she wanted
She did not like the market

questions.text: How does Mia's mom probably feel about the purchase?
options: She is glad to help Mia
She is tired of the market
She does not know about it

vocabulary.definition: a place where people buy and sell food and goods
kind and pleasant to other people

paragraph_translations: Мія ходить на ринок зі своєю мамою. Їм потрібні яблука, хліб і молоко. На ринку багато людей, а продавці привітні. Мія несе сумку з яблуками.
На ринку Мія бачить синій капелюх. Він коштує п'ять доларів. Мама каже «так», тож Мія купує капелюх. Тепер Мія дуже щаслива.
